title: Cancellation of base change for tensor products of algebras
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $B$ a commutative $R$-algebra and $A$ a commutative $S$-algebra, regarded as an $R$-algebra via $R\to S\to A$. Then there is an isomorphism of $A$-algebras $A\otimes_S(S\otimes_RB)\xrightarrow{\sim}A\otimes_RB$, $a\otimes(s\otimes b)\mapsto sa\otimes b$, with inverse $a\otimes b\mapsto a\otimes(1\otimes b)$.
